text:
nina: HeliosCare legal needs three items for their vendor intake: a short DPA clause about uploads, confirmation of which KMS scheme we use for embeddings, and whether any vendor has direct object-store access. They also want a tiny code example for a 15m presigned PUT they can paste into docs. Can we draft?
sam: TL;DR: hosted defaults to 1h presigned URLs; we can issue 15m on request. By default URLs are not single-use. Embeddings & persisted artifacts are encrypted at rest with keys managed by Redwood in hosted. For Private/Dedicated we support customer keys (BYOK). Subprocessors (cloud infra, observability, auth provider) do not get direct S3 access to customer buckets in hosted; access goes through our service layer and is logged.
jon: For legal language, keep it short and categorical. They usually accept a one-paragraph statement plus an offer to supply redacted vendor list + SOC2 cover page under NDA.
legal: Draft paragraph would be great. Also they asked: can we implement single-use presigned semantics now or is that roadmap? They want an ETA if yes.
sam: Single-use requires server-side state for token redemption. We have an upload-proxy microservice that can mint single-use upload tokens; not enabled by default for every account. We can offer it as an opt-in engineering change; depending on priority it's a 1-2 sprint work item to expose for hosted customers.
jon: Here's a short DPA-ready clause I suggest: 
"Redwood Inference provides time-limited presigned URLs for customer artifact uploads. By default, presigned URLs in the hosted service expire after one hour; upon request Redwood can issue shorter expirations (for example, fifteen minutes). Presigned URLs are time-bound and, unless otherwise agreed, are not single-use; Redwood can implement single-use upload tokens upon request subject to mutual agreement and scheduling. Persisted customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed by Redwood in hosted deployments. For Dedicated and Private deployments, Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) and will provide key usage descriptions under NDA. Redwood does not provide subprocessors with direct read or write access to customer object stores; subprocessors operate under contract and access data only via the Redwood service layer which enforces access controls and logging."
ops: They asked for a code snippet. Quick 15m example with boto3 below. Also adding a curl example for our upload-proxy that demonstrates single-use token flow.
sam: ```python
import boto3

s3 = boto3.client('s3', region_name='us-west-2')
url = s3.generate_presigned_url('put_object', Params={'Bucket': 'redwood-customer-uploads', 'Key': 'helioscare/record-123.json'}, ExpiresIn=900)
print(url)
```
ops: single-use proxy flow (curl):
1) POST to Redwood upload-proxy to request token:
   curl -X POST https://uploads.redwood.ai/v1/tokens -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" -d '{"key":"helioscare/record-123.json","expires":900}'
   -> returns {"upload_url":"https://s3-presigned.example/...","nonce":"abc123"}
2) PUT to upload_url with file, proxy records nonce and marks used after success. Subsequent attempts with same nonce are rejected.
security-bot: Evidence package staged: /datarooms/helioscare/soc2-cover.pdf (access gated). :white_check_mark:
nina: Legal follow-up: please include a tiny checklist for HeliosCare before we hand evidence: 1) NDA signed 2) desired presigned expiry (15m or 1h) 3) single-use required? 4) BYOK for Dedicated/Private? 5) contact for technical call.
jon: small typo: @nina you mean @jon ;).
jon: I'll send the paragraph + snippets to HeliosCare legal. @sam can you add a short ETA for single-use support in the note: "opt-in feature, estimated 2 sprints after sign-off"?
sam: ETA: opt-in single-use support available as an engineering change; estimate 6 business days after internal kickoff (subject to prioritization).
legal: Good. One ask: when you provide KMS details in the evidence bundle, avoid full ARNs. State region and whether Redwood-managed CMK or customer-managed.
sam: Got it. I'll produce a KMS summary line: "Hosted: Redwood-managed CMKs in customer region; Dedicated/Private: BYOK supported. Detailed key identifiers available under NDA."
nina: Perfect. Action items: @sam prepare KMS summary + snippet edit for proxy; @jon send the DPA paragraph + snippets to HeliosCare; @ops confirm dataroom upload. Will schedule a 30m sync if they want a walkthrough.
